Measures
The Social Interaction Anxiety Scale (SIAS) was used to measure social interaction anxiety. The scale demonstrated good internal consistency in the present sample, with a Cronbach’s alpha of 0.9.
The Experiences in Close Relationships Anxiety Subscale was used to measure attachment-related anxiety. Its Cronbach’s alpha was 0.94.
The Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale was used to measure self-esteem. Its Cronbach’s alpha was 0.85.


Data Analysis Strategy
The questionnaire items were scored using the scoreItems() function. Reverse keying was applied to the specified items before calculating the scale scores. For the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale, items 5, 9, and 11 were reverse-keyed. For the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale, items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 were reverse-keyed. No items were reverse-keyed for the Attachment Anxiety scale. Average scores were then calculated for each scale.
